headline: Shadcn/UI now defaults to Base UI instead of Radix
summary: Shadcn/UI has changed its default to Base UI, moving away from Radix.
details: The Shadcn/UI project has announced a significant change in its default configuration, switching from Radix to Base UI. This alteration aims to improve the user interface and experience for developers utilizing the Shadcn/UI framework.

Shadcn/UI is a popular open-source project that provides a set of reusable UI components for building web applications. The decision to change the default UI library is expected to impact the development community.
Base UI is known for its flexibility and customization capabilities, which may offer developers more options for designing and implementing user interfaces.

headline_marked: [[Cognee gives AI long-term memory]] with 27k+ GitHub stars
headline: Cognee gives AI long-term memory with 27k+ GitHub stars
summary: Cognee helps AI remember information across conversations
details: Most AI models don't remember past conversations on their own. They start from scratch every time, requiring users to explain everything again.
Cognee changes this by giving AI a way to remember what matters. It learns from documents, files, websites, or notes and uses that knowledge whenever needed.
Unlike traditional RAG systems, Cognee understands how different pieces of information are connected, providing more accurate and meaningful answers.
Cognee is Apache-2.0, runs locally by default, and has over 27,000 GitHub stars. It's useful for AI assistants, chatbots, coding assistants, customer support, and more.
If your AI needs to remember users, projects, or previous conversations over time, Cognee is worth exploring.
caption:
Can AI ever truly remember you? Cognee says yes with 27k+ GitHub stars

Most AI models don't remember past conversations on their own. They start from scratch every time, requiring users to explain everything again.

Cognee changes this by giving AI a way to remember what matters. It learns from documents, files, websites, or notes and uses that knowledge whenever needed.

Unlike traditional RAG systems, Cognee understands how different pieces of information are connected, providing more accurate and meaningful answers.

Cognee is Apache-2.0, runs locally by default, and has over 27,000 GitHub stars. It's useful for AI assistants, chatbots, coding assistants, customer support, and more.

If your AI needs to remember users, projects, or previous conversations over time, Cognee is worth exploring.
